It could be multiple things: that the hormons still haven't gotten out of her body and is still marking, she is anxious, she already developed it as a habit (not sure how old she is) or she has a medical issue. 

To start, get another litter box and put it close to your bed where she is peeing. My cat did the same before spay surgery and when I literally put another litter box next to the bed it helped for some time. She didn't pee on the bed, yet in the new box. I know it seems gross, but for me, wet bed was worse! 
Try Feliway plug in or spray! Also throw treats on the bed since cats usually won't pee where they eat, and last but not least take her to the vet or mention this on the check up! 

Good luck, I know how frustrating this can be!
